perception.note: Low light vision, Scent 30ft imprecise, bloodsense (precise) 60 feet

generalAbilities.name: Blood Quarry
generalAbilities.description: On smelling a creature's blood, the blood boar can designate that creature as its quarry. The blood boar can smell its quarry from up to a mile away. A blood boar can have only one quarry at a time.

generalAbilities.name: Bloodsense
generalAbilities.description: The blood boar can precisely sense bleeding creatures within 60 feet.

defensiveAbilities.name: Ferocity
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger The monster is reduced to 0 HP.

Effect The monster avoids being knocked out and remains at 1 HP, but its Wounded value increases by 1. When it is Wounded 3, it can no longer use this ability

offensiveAbilities.name: Chase Down
offensiveAbilities.description: The blood boar Strides toward its quarry, ignoring difficult terrain and gaining a +10-foot circumstance bonus to its Speed during the movement.

offensiveAbilities.name: Terrifying Squeal
offensiveAbilities.description:
The blood boar lets forth a hair-raising squeal. Each creature within 30 feet must succeed at a DC 23 Will Saving Throw save or become Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure).

If the blood boar uses Terrifying Squeal on the same turn after using Chase Down, the DC 25 Will Saving Throw save DC is instead 25.
